items.title: October 20, 2026
items.summary: Cloud SDKBreaking590.0.0 (2026-10-20)Breaking Changes(Google Cloud CLI) Removed the gcloud-man-pages component. Use --help for full command documentation.(App Engine) Removed the app-engine-grpc component from the Google Cloud CLI.(Cloud Build) Removed the Cloud Build Local Builder component (cloud-build-local) from the Google Cloud CLI.Google Cloud CLIUpdated bundled Python on Linux and Windows, and in the Alpine-based Dockerimages, to pyOpenSSL 26.4.0 and cryptography 50.0.1. 32-bit Windows usespyOpenSSL 26.2.0 and cryptography 48.0.1, the newest releases that support it.AIUpdated gcloud beta ai endpoints deploy-model to request automatic resources for Gemini deployments on GDC connected endpoints.If no replica counts are specified, the minimum replica count defaults to 1 only for gemini-2.5-flash.Specifying flags that apply only to dedicated resources, such as --machine-type or --accelerator, now prints a warning and deploys with dedicated resources.Agent IdentityAdded gcloud beta agent-identity auth-providers resolve-authorizationcommand.AlloyDBAdded --enable-public-dns flag to gcloud beta alloydb instances create|update.ApigeeFixed an issue where gcloud apigee commands would fail with anUnauthorizedRequestError for users who authenticate using Mutual TLS (mTLS).App EngineUpdated gcloud beta app migrate-to-run to default to the App Engineapplication's region instead of us-central1 when neither --region northe run/region property is set.BigLakePromoted --federated-catalog-identity-mode for gcloud biglake icebergcatalogs create to GA.Promoted --federated-catalog-identity-mode for gcloud biglake icebergcatalogs update to GA.Promoted --metadata-service-directory-name for gcloud biglake icebergcatalogs create to GA.Promoted --metadata-service-directory-name for gcloud biglake icebergcatalogs update to GA.federated value for --catalog-type flag of gcloud biglake icebergcatalogs create is now supported.Certificate Authority ServiceAdded --filter flag to gcloud privateca subordinates list. The flag isable to allow filtering results based on specified boolean expression.Cloud BigtableBuild with 1.26.4 to resolve CVE-2026-39820.Cloud Bigtable EmulatorRebuild cbt-emulator for CVE-2026-39820.Cloud DataflowPromoted gcloud dataflow config-store-settings to GA.Cloud DataplexFixed gcloud dataplex dbt metadata-jobs create so that dbt resources whosenames contain a dot, such as tests on a model with a decimal version, are nolonger rejected by the import job.Fixed gcloud dataplex dbt metadata-jobs create so that two dbt resourcesthat map to the same Dataplex entry ID no longer fail the whole import job.The first is imported and a warning names the other.Cloud IAMAdded --vendor-type flag to gcloud iam workforce-pools providers create-oidc, create-saml, update-oidc, and update-saml commands.Cloud Resource ManagerPromoted gcloud resource-manager capability-configs to GA.Promoted gcloud resource-manager boundary-configs to GA.Promoted gcloud resource-manager boundaries to GA.Cloud RunAdded --dry-run flag to gcloud beta run domain-mappings create tovalidate a domain mapping, including whether the domain is available,without creating it.Cloud SQLAdded POSTGRES_19 to --database-version flag of gcloud sql instances create and gcloud sql instances patch.Added --no-replication-lag-max-seconds-for-recreate flag to gcloud beta sql instances patch to disable recreating a lagging MySQL read replica.Updated 'cloud-sql-proxy' packaged component to use 2.26.2 of the Cloud SQL Proxy.Cloud SpannerImproved error output when gcloud spanner cli runs an incompatiblespanner-cli binary found on PATH instead of the spanner-clicomponent; users are now directed to install the component.Cloud WorkstationsAdded enable-automatic-failover to --boost-config flag in gcloud beta workstations configs create and gcloud beta workstations configs update.Compute EngineAdded compute instance-templates export command to all release tracks.Removed WORKLOAD_IDENTITY choise in --identity-type flag.Promoted --instance-flexibility-policy flag and min CPU platform and diskoverrides to GA for gcloud compute instance-groups managed create andupdate.Added compute instance-templates import command to all release tracks.Database MigrationAdded --failback flag to gcloud database-migration migration-jobspromote command to promote a migration job from destination back to sourceduring the FAILBACK phase.GKE HubPromoted --view, --memberships, --filter, and --sort-by flags ongcloud container fleet|hub config-management describe command to GA.Updated gcloud container fleet|hub memberships register to allow skipping the Connect agent installation on non-GKE clusters via the --no-install-connect-agent flag.Kubernetes EngineAdded the reservedSystemCpus kubelet config option to the gcloudcontainer clusters create, gcloud container node-pools create, andgcloud container node-pools update commands. This option specifies thelist of CPUs reserved for host system services.Added ltsc2025 op
